title: Avoid repeated Codex launcher artifact observation after an unchanged locator
outcome: A Codex launcher locator is validated and observed when first established or changed, without repeating canonicalization, disk reads, unchanged persistence and run refresh for every later output delta.
acceptance: Unchanged later output deltas do not repeat launcher artifact I/O or unchanged persistence.
First locator, conflicting locator, runtime/generation fences and native association behavior remain covered; no check or credit is invented.
